meta.title: Nauta — your business, unified
meta.description: Nauta gathers every tool you already use into one operations cockpit, with a fractional CTO ready to run it when you need one. Self-serve ERP per seat; vCTO when you want someone to run it for you.

hero.title: Your business, unified.
hero.subtitle: One login gathers every MADFAM service your company is entitled to —invoicing, scheduling, money, compliance— into a single operations cockpit. And when you want someone to run it for you, step up to the vCTO.

pillars.title: Why Nauta
pillars.subtitle: Not one more tool. The place where all your tools live together.

oneLogin.title: One login
oneLogin.description: One identity across the whole ecosystem. Sign in once and every service you're entitled to is right there —no twelve passwords, no twelve tabs.

salidaDigna.title: Yours to keep
salidaDigna.description: Dignified exit by design. If you ever leave the vCTO, the ERP and your data stay yours. You're never held hostage by your provider.

fiscalNative.title: Mexican-fiscal native
fiscalNative.description: CFDI, RFC and SAT compliance built in from day one —not bolted on afterward. Built to operate in Mexico, not force-fit to it.

vctoOnTap.title: A CTO when you want one
vctoOnTap.description: Rather have someone run it? Step up to the vCTO and a technical operator runs the stack for you. Move up or down a tier without losing anything.

product.title: Two ways to use Nauta
product.subtitle: Start self-serve with the ERP. When you want us to run it for you, step up to the vCTO. Same business, same login —nothing is lost moving between tiers.

erp.name: Nauta ERP
erp.oneLine: Gathers every service you're entitled to in one place, and you run it yourself. Self-serve, per seat.
erp.valueVs: Replaces the tangle of scattered subscriptions and spreadsheets with a single cockpit —at a fraction of what a traditional ERP costs.

vcto.name: Nauta vCTO
vcto.oneLine: A fractional CTO and team run your stack: they decide, integrate and execute for you. Scoped to fit.
vcto.valueVs: A full-time head of technology costs millions a year. The vCTO gives you that operating capacity for a fraction, and only when you need it.

product.pricePending: Price not yet set — it appears here the moment it is ratified.

catalog.title: What Nauta brings together
catalog.subtitle: Each of these services lives under one login in your ERP. Start with one; add the rest as you need them.
catalog.note: Each service's price lives on its own page. The ERP brings them together under one login.

closing.title: Start wherever it makes sense for you.
closing.subtitle: Try the ERP self-serve today, or book a call and we'll design together how the vCTO runs your technology.
